text: Small daily progress is still progress. Open one unit and finish it.
Mistakes are data. Review the explanation, then try a similar question.
Active recall beats re-reading. Cover the answer and say it out loud.
Sleep is part of studying. Your brain consolidates what you practiced.
Teach a concept to an imaginary classmate. If you can explain it, you own it.
Do the hardest question first while your mind is fresh.
Consistency > intensity. 25 focused minutes daily beats a weekly panic session.
Math is a language. Fluency comes from speaking it — practice problems.
You do not need motivation every day. You need a system and a start button.
Past papers train exam stamina. Time yourself once a week.
Write one summary sentence after each section. That sentence is your memory hook.
Compare wrong answers with the key. Name the exact misconception.
